name: Short Cut Japanese Pork & Mixed Veggie Curry with Jasmine Rice

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
454 g lean ground pork
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add water to the pot and bring to a boil. Once boiling, add veggies, reduce heat, and simmer until veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Crumble curry mix block into the pot. Stir until incorporated, then return to medium heat and simmer until thickened, 3-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, working one at a time, place rice pouches in the microwave, seam-side up. Heat on high for 3-4 minutes (until pouch balloons up with steam for 30 seconds). Allow steam to vent before opening pouch. (Alternatively, rice can be heated in a saucepan according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (283 g) pouch frozen Jasmine rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
